content:
This is my first post on my brand new blog, running on Hugo with the PaperMod theme.
Why a blog? To write down what I learn — mostly about tech, hosting, and the stuff I tinker with.
What works already Code blocks with syntax highlighting: def hello(): print("Hello from Hugo + PaperMod!") Tags, search, archives, dark mode, RSS Markdown formatting: bold, italics, links Publishing When I hit publish, it’s just:
git add . && git commit -m "new post" && git push … and the site rebuilds automatically.
More soon.
summary:
This is my first post on my brand new blog, running on Hugo with the PaperMod theme.

Why a blog?

To write down what I learn — mostly about tech, hosting, and the stuff I tinker with.

What works already

  • Code blocks with syntax highlighting:
def hello():
    print("Hello from Hugo + PaperMod!")
  • Tags, search, archives, dark mode, RSS
  • Markdown formatting: bold, italics, links

Publishing

When I hit publish, it’s just:

git add . && git commit -m "new post" && git push

… and the site rebuilds automatically.
title: Hello World — My First Post
